title: Yale SOM 50: how to build and sustain a mission-driven company
summary: Yale School of Management is marking its 50th anniversary with a session featuring Eric alongside two SOM alumni, Judy Samuelson of the Aspen Institute's Business and Society Program and Josh Geballe of Yale Ventures. Yale frames it around whether governance structures can be built to sustain mission-driven companies, and is holding it during SOM Social Impact Week.
attribution_title: Yale SOM 50 · Evans Hall, 165 Whitney Avenue, New Haven · Wednesday December 2, 2026 · 4:00–5:20 pm EST
blockquote: Many companies are founded with a mission. But success brings new challenges—investors, incentives, and expanding systems—that can push growing companies away from their original purpose.
